race.comment: DEMARCATE (2) was just out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start when he settled well back over 1250m at Gunnedah, beaten 2 lengths into fourth. Looks well placed so expect a better run this time. JADE DIVISION (9) finished 2.9 lengths away from the winner last time at Coonabarabran on soft going and drops in the weights. Best figures should see him run well. BILLABONG ROSE (4) closed off strongly last start to get up for second, beaten only a nose, over 1120m at Dubbo when coming back from a break. Strips fitter now and rates among the main hopes. THE CONFIDANTE (6) is a last-start winner with a claim and shouldn't be underestimated.
